title: The Real Reason Kids Are Becoming Instagram Spiritual Gurus
description:
India has become a playground for fake gurus and baby babas, where even children as young as 3 or 4 are turned into spiritual influencers. From Abhinav Arora’s Instagram reels to the rise of child kathavachaks like Bhakt Bhagwan Das, Jaya Kishori, Devanshi Sanghvi, and Palak Kishori, religion is being rebranded as a business where blind faith is the currency.

In this video, Pale Blue Thoughts investigates the baby baba phenomenon. We expose how children are manipulated by their parents to act as spiritual gurus, propped up by podcasters, media houses, and politicians hungry for votes. From staged bhakti videos to merchandise, this is nothing more than spiritual clickbait.

We look at Abhinav Arora’s viral rise, his father’s marketing schemes, and the Only Desi expose linking the family to earlier scams. We examine why educated Indians fall for such pseudoscience: childhood indoctrination, herd mentality, fear of alienation, cognitive dissonance, and the glorification of gurus in Bollywood and media. Gurus like Sadhguru and Nithyananda blend pseudoscience with charisma, while baby babas add a layer of “cuteness” to keep the blind faith flowing.

If you’ve searched for baby babas exposed, Abhinav Arora guru scam, child sants India, fake gurus debunked, blind faith India, or why Indians follow babas, this documentary lays out the truth.

comments.text:
Hi Anand. Great video as usual, but there is one aspect in this video where I disagree with you. It is regarding the clip from the Ellen DeGeneres show. While I understand the point you are trying to make, i.e. installing scientific literacy in kids, it somehow gives an impression as if US kids are more scientifically literate than Indian kids. By doing so, all the issues within the Bible Belt viz, homeschooling, Christian fundamentalism, creationism, flat earth belief, anti-vaccination - seem to be conveniently ignored.

I would have been more happier if you had shown a video of an Indian-Hindu kid talking about scientists, or some kid from Nordic country doing the same . The issue faced by rational Americans are same as those faced by rational Indians. Imposition of Christianity in public sphere vs imposition of irrational Hinduism in public sphere. (which are expected to worsen when Trump takes over).

Just my two paisas.
